name: btrc
description: Language support for btrc — a language that transpiles to C

btrc.pythonPath.description: Path to Python 3 interpreter for the btrc language server

btrc.serverPath.description: Absolute path to the btrc LSP server script (server.py). When set, the extension uses this directly instead of searching for it.

btrc.serverCommand.description: Command or absolute path for the btrc language server. The Nix package exports `btrc-lsp`, which provides the Python dependencies required for diagnostics, go-to-definition, hover, completion, and signature help.

btrc.useNixDevShell.description: When the project has a flake.nix and `nix` is on PATH, run the language server inside the Nix dev shell (which provides the pinned Python 3.13+ with pygls/lsprotocol). A local src/devex/lsp/.venv or an explicit btrc.pythonPath takes precedence, so no manual venv is needed.

btrc.trace.server.description: Traces the communication between VS Code and the btrc language server

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run prepare-lsp && npm run esbuild-base
